title: Jhoola Jhulaane wali Aansu baha rahi hai
body:
JHULA JHULANE WALI AANSU BAHA RAHI HAI
Nanha sipahi mera besheer wo kahan hai
Sabr-o-sukoon ki meri tasweer wo kahan hai
Jaakar kahan mai dhundun taqdeer wo kahan hai
<<MINI>>
Asghar chale bhi aao madar bula rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekha hai chand mera kya tumne aye sitaro
Aya tumhari janib darya ke aye kanaro
Kuch to pata batao jungle ke aye baharo
<<MINI>>
Asghar chale bhi aao madar bula rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir le gaye the pani tumhe pilane
Ada-e-deen ko shayad mazloomiyat dikhane
Kis dil se mai ne bheja maidaan ko na jane
<<MINI>>
Asghar chale bhi aao madar bula rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Un zalimon ne shayad pani diya to hoga
Pyase the teen din ke pani piya to hoga
Shayad sukoon run mein tumko mila to hoga
<<MINI>>
Asghar chale bhi aao madar bula rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Aya na koi wapas maidaa’n ko jo gaya hai
Tum bhi na aa sakoge dil mera keh raha hai
Ankhon mein teen din se kyun khoon phir raha hai
<<MINI>>
Asghar chale bhi aao madar bula rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Afsoos hurmula ne teer-e-sitam wo maara
Maa ki murado’n wale bache ka halq cheda
Khaya Wafa na us ne kuch khauf bhi khuda ka
<<MINI>>
Asghar chale bhi aao madar bula rahi hai
